entries.b112369158cb7bba: Asahi Net, Inc. is an independent internet service provider headquartered in Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo. It does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and as of March 31, 2026, it had 220 employees. It was founded in 1990 with capital from The Asahi Shimbun Company and others, and in 2000 its officers and employees acquired all of its shares, making it independent.
entries.b4e6becf86bc5765: A service that provides internet connection environments to customers. It combines a backbone line operated with the company's own technology and access lines of partner telecommunications carriers to offer "AsahiNet Hikari" FTTH connections, mobile connections and other services. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,202 million, of which ¥9,786 million was from the member-oriented ISP "ASAHI Net", and ¥2,415 million was from the VNE "v6 Connect", which wholesales IPv6 connectivity to telecommunications carriers.
